body_markdown:
**Newark, Delaware, November 10, 2026** – Artesian Resources Corporation (Nasdaq: ARTNA), a leading provider on the Delmarva Peninsula of water and wastewater services, and other related business services, today announced third quarter and year-to-date results for 2026.


***Third Quarter Results***


Diluted net income per share decreased to $0.65, compared to $0.68 for the same period in 2025. Net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $6.8 million, a $0.2 million, or 3.0%, decrease compared to net income recorded during the three months ended September 30, 2025.


Revenues totaled $31.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, $1.5 million, or 4.8%, more than revenues for the three months ended September 30, 2025.[Read More.](https://www.artesianwater.com/wp-content/uploads/3Q-2026-Earnings-Release-FINAL-release-and-table.pdf)
